name: Tom su Ca Mau
summary: Tôm sú Cà Mau is the province's black tiger prawn, protected by a geographical indication alongside cua Cà Mau.
origin: Cà Mau. Nhân Dân, reporting the workshop of 23 December 2022, pairs the tôm sú indication with the crab.
howToEat: Ask for it by name as tôm sú Cà Mau. Mangrove crab is the other protected plate.
seoTitle: Tom su Ca Mau — the protected prawn
seoDescription: Tôm sú Cà Mau is the province's black tiger prawn, a geographical indication paired with cua Cà Mau.
